newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury's Summers encouraged by Russia moves.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury's Summers encouraged by Russia moves.

text.p: Deputy U.S. Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers said he was encouraged by Russian President Boris Yeltsin's promises to accelerate economic reform, but said there was still much to be done.
"I think the moment is pregnant in Russia. There's a real chance for real reform," Summers said on Public Broadcasting System's Nightly Business Report program.
Summers called on Russia to fix its tax system so the government could pay workers the wages they were owed, to establish property rules and put in place an effective social safety net.

Asked if Washington was offering to help Russia join the World Trade Organization in return for Russian acquiescence on NATO expansion, Summers said, "We are not going to buy our way into NATO expansion."
Summers has just returned from a trip to Moscow to prepare for the upcoming summit between President Clinton and Yeltsin.
